lines.t: Oh woman walking the earth
From childhood, you could see
The sorrow behind every smile
And the hurt in broken families
You knew there was more to this life
Than the empty ways they chose
A longing stirred within your heart
For the truth that only He could show
Born to stand apart, apart, apart
With a fire for the truth inside your heart
A bright flame in the dark, dark, dark.
When your flesh pulls you away from the light,
Look into His eyes; let all else fade from sight.
Burn, burn, burn—burn bright
Oh woman walking the earth
Called to be set apart
Forsaking the world’s ways
With truth burning in your heart
A grief grips your spirit
As you watch the world forsake Him
Turning further from the truth
As the days grow darker
Born to stand apart, apart, apart
With a fire for the truth inside your heart
A bright flame in the dark, dark, dark.
When your flesh pulls you away from the light,
Look into His eyes; let all else fade from sight.
Burn, burn, burn—burn bright
Though at times your road winds
Your heart still longs for Him
All it takes is one look into His deep eyes
To draw you close again
His love rekindles zeal within
And sets your heart ablaze
Burn, burn, burn
Burn bright
